doc: What fires when on the jobs board. The swipe route and the pipeline read this; scripts/jobs_trigger_eval.mjs asserts the live rows match it. Tiers come from runtime/specs/target-role-scan.json.

tiers.doc: A right swipe queues a forge on any tier. On a confirm tier the run is flagged so the watcher asks before spending a cut; on an auto tier it runs as soon as capacity allows.

rules.when: swipe right on a scored row with no forge run
rules.then: forge run created, status queued, requestedAt = swipe time

rules.when: swipe right on a confirm-tier row
rules.then: same as right-queues, plus notes = 'below auto tier: confirm before spending a cut'

rules.when: swipe right on an UNSCORED row
rules.then: swipe recorded, no forge run; the row must be scored first

rules.when: swipe cleared while the run is still queued
swipe left while the run is still queued
swipe left after the run is past queued
rules.then: run kept as is; nothing is hosted
extra runs stay queued in requestedAt order, never dropped

rules.when: a run executes from a swipe
rules.then: blueprint stages 1, 5, 7, 8, 9 only; stages 2, 3, 4, 6 need a recorded human reply
landing page in _ARTIFACTS/forge-<slug>/page.html, not in public/; url stays null
url set only after a human-approved deploy; only then does the board link

invariants.check: every forge run with status queued has a right swipe on its row
no forge run exists on a row with band UNSCORED
every queued run on a confirm-tier row carries the confirm note
every run with status live has a non-null url
every run with status built has a null url
every run status is one of queued, gathering, grading, rendering, built, live
a why tag exists only on left swipes
